safety.title: Safety & privacy: encrypted and stored in the EU · KINND
safety.description: Photos, videos, messages and medical information encrypted with AES-256-GCM, mandatory two-step sign-in and all data stored in the EU. Our promises, in plain words.

hero.title: Built to *protect* children’s data

promises.title: Photos are locked

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.title: Locked, *every* step of the way
encryption.text: Your most sensitive information is encrypted when it is stored and when it travels.

items.title: When it is stored
items.text: Photos, videos, messages and medical information are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, the standard banks and governments use. Each photo and video gets its own key.

items.title: When it travels
items.text: Everything between your phone and KINND is sent over an encrypted connection (TLS 1.3). Nobody on the network can read it.

items.title: Keys kept apart
items.text: The keys that unlock your data are stored separately from the data itself. A copy of the data alone is unreadable.

protected.label: What is protected
protected.title: What is *protected*
protected.text: Find what matters to you, and see how it is kept safe.

rows.how: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM, own key per file. Location removed from copies others download.
Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Only the people in the conversation can open them.
Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Parents, and adults a parent gives access.
Encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Only adults with access to that child, by role.
Two-step sign-in, always on. Signing in with a password needs a one-time code, sent by email or SMS.
Handled by QuickPay. KINND never stores full card numbers.
Encrypted the same way as live data, kept for 90 days in the EU.
IP addresses, device information and sign-in history are kept for 1 year, only to detect and report misuse.

oversight.label: What we can see
oversight.title: Built to keep *children* safe
oversight.text: Our management system watches for misuse around the clock with Abuse Central, a complex system of triggers and patterns. Every alarm is checked by a person on our team.

items.title: Family life stays private
items.text: In normal use, nobody at KINND sees your photos, messages or your child's information. Our system works on technical signals only.

items.title: When an alarm goes off
items.text: Our team first reviews the technical details of the case: sign-ins, devices, IP addresses and the warnings that fired. Every view is audited. If there are grounds to look further, we follow the same protocols as the Danish authorities, and a second, senior reviewer approves before the case goes further.

items.title: Every look is audited
items.text: Every time an employee views details in a case, it is logged with who, what and when, and audited.

abuse.label: Abuse and fraud
abuse.title: How we catch *abuse* and fraud
abuse.text: We act on misuse quickly, with technical signals only.

items.title: Warnings that catch misuse early
items.text: Abuse Central looks for signs of misuse: unusual sign-ins, accounts created to reach a child, and attempts to get access someone should not have.

items.title: You decide who is in
items.text: Parents can remove a family member at any time. Worried about something? Write to us.

items.title: We work with the authorities
items.text: Confirmed illegal cases are handed to the police with the information they need. We follow each case until it is closed.

items.title: We stay out of family conflicts
items.text: KINND is a private space to share in. We do not take sides or settle disagreements.

hero.title: Questions and *answers*
hero.text: Short answers to what parents ask most.

items.a: KINND is a private family app for parents who live apart and the family around their children. Both homes share the custody calendar, appointments, school days, health information, lists, photos and Moments in one place, and invite grandparents and others they trust. KINND is made by WURK ApS in Copenhagen, Denmark, and all data is stored in the EU.
It runs in your browser and works like an app. Add it to your home screen. No app store needed.
The app and this website are in nine languages: English, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Faroese, Icelandic, German, Turkish and Arabic.

items.q: Does the other parent need to pay?
items.a: No. Your co-parent is included in your plan when you invite them.
Only what you share with them. Each adult sees what their role allows.
Parents. Grandparents and caregivers need the Family plan.
Free is 0 DKK. Parents is 29 DKK a month. Family is 69 DKK a month.

items.q: What happens after the 30 free days?
items.a: You pick a plan. If you pick nothing, you move to Free.
Yes, at any time. You keep your plan until the period ends.
Media and sensitive information are encrypted. Sign-in requires two steps.
Not in normal use. Photos are encrypted, each with its own key. Our team only looks into a case when an alarm goes off, and every look is logged.

items.q: What happens if someone misuses KINND?
items.a: Our warning engine flags it and a person on our team looks into it. Confirmed illegal cases go to the police.
Yes. Your data, your choice. Download or delete your account on demand.
No. KINND is a place to share in. We do not take sides.
